source: x.com profile timeline, public view counts + engagement read from DOM
coverage_limitation: Full Jan-Aug data could NOT be obtained. X Analytics (owner-only impressions) is gated behind X Premium, which this account does not have. The public profile timeline stops serving posts older than ~mid-May, and X search (from:SantiamHospital since:2026-01-01 until:2026-05-26) returned only a single result. The 40-post sample is therefore the defensible evidence base; it is consistent and unambiguous.
interpretation: X is effectively dormant as an audience channel. 40 posts produced 470 total views (median 11) and 3 total likes. Reach per post is roughly 0.8% of the 1,397 follower base. Note the account follows 1,550 accounts vs 1,397 followers, typical of an unmanaged/auto-follow legacy account.
